title: How Much Fiber in Flaxseed? 2.8g per Tbsp
description: Flaxseed: about 2.8 g of fiber per 1 tbsp, whole (10% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in flaxseed?
intro: Flaxseed ranks #4 of 7 nuts, seeds, and treats on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in flaxseed by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in flaxseed?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists seeds, flaxseed at 27.3 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 tbsp, whole; 10.3 g) therefore has about 2.8 g of fiber and 55 calories. That is 10% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 11% of a 25 g day and 7% of a 38 g day.
Flaxseed is one of the most fiber-dense foods by weight, with both soluble mucilage and insoluble fiber. Ground flax is also a common source of the plant omega-3 fat ALA.

sections.heading: Whole vs ground flax
paragraphs: Whole flaxseeds often pass through the gut intact, so grinding is recommended to absorb the fats. For fiber, both forms count. A tablespoon of ground flax weighs less than a tablespoon of whole seeds, so it has less fiber per spoon.
Ground flax goes rancid faster. Store it in the fridge or freezer, or grind small batches.

sections.heading: How flaxseed compares with other nuts, seeds, and treats
paragraphs: Of the 7 nuts, seeds, and treats on this site, flaxseed ranks #4 for fiber per typical serving and #1 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 5.1 g of fiber per 100 calories, a high ratio: you get a lot of fiber for the calories.

Close neighbors by serving: [pistachios](/fiber-in-pistachios) at 2.9 g (1 oz (about 49 kernels)); [dark chocolate](/fiber-in-dark-chocolate) at 3.1 g (1 oz (70–85% cacao)); [almonds](/fiber-in-almonds) at 3.5 g (1 oz (about 23 almonds)). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), flaxseed is #22 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding flaxseed to your day
paragraphs: Stir 1–2 tablespoons of ground flax into oatmeal, yogurt, smoothies, or pancake batter. Increase gradually and drink water.

Example: 2 tbsp ground flaxseed, 1 cup oatmeal, 1/2 cup raspberries. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 11.8 g of fiber, with 3.8 g from the flaxseed. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of flaxseed?
faqs.a: 27.3 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Seeds, flaxseed). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in flaxseed (1 tbsp, ground)?
faqs.a: About 1.9 g, for 7 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.
Per tablespoon, chia is a little higher. Chia is about 4.1 g per tablespoon on the [chia seeds](/chia-seeds) guide; whole flax is about 2.8 g (1 tbsp, whole).
Many people use 1–2 tablespoons of ground flax a day. If you take medications, ask your pharmacist, since large amounts of fiber can affect absorption timing.
